items.title: Landon Dickerson feels he let team down in his return to lineup
items.text: The Eagles got left guard Landon Dickerson back in the lineup for Monday night's game against the Cowboys, but his return wasn't enough to snap the team's losing streak.

items.title: Javonte Williams: Good to give confidence to keep calling runs
items.text: Given the number of factors that go into determining winners and losers in NFL games, it's hard to pin the Cowboys' back-to-back losses solely on running back Javonte Williams carrying the ball 23 times in Weeks 5 and 6.

items.title: Cowboys are the betting favorites to win the NFC East after win in Philadelphia

items.title: Saquon Barkley addressed teammates after loss: "Never quit, never give up"

items.title: Oregon QB Dante Moore won't return this season from his concussion
